As a workaround, you could use Ollama through external Agent frameworks.

available_sources.excerpt: In the past few weeks, I have been experimenting with ReAct and CodeAct agent patterns. And patterns have practical limitations in practice. For ReAct, because tool calling behaviors vary across LLM providers, it is hard to guarantee consistent ReAct behaviors across LLM models. For CodeAct, while the idea of writing code to replace JSON schema sounds appealing, the reality is that many CodeAct agents are built on top of the existing infrastructure of JSON tool calls.
